Concept dashboard, using a supplied plot plan. All 10,000 worker records, counts, scan times and alerts are synthetic demonstration data. Entry / exit totals assume valid gate scans; zone changes assume directional checkpoint events. Muster locations are proposed for illustration and require the site's approved emergency plan. Worker names are demo aliases; seven illustrative days are available (8–14 Oct 2026). Movement arrows are straight vectors between RFID checkpoints, not surveyed walking paths or continuous tracking. Subcontractor names, work packages and floor assignments are also synthetic. Demonstration floor lists (B1 and L1–L7 where applicable) are not verified building levels; the supplied plan remains the overall L1 site reference. Floor identity requires a reader configured to that floor, such as at a stair core or hoist. No live system is connected.
